summary: Rollover on westbound Highway 58 west of Tucker Road with unknown injuries. Multi-unit response including a battalion chief with an air unit on standby; westbound lanes reduced as crews worked the scene.
Reports of five to six shots fired at a residence, with subjects in ski masks seen at the door. The caller was checking cameras as a vehicle fled the area. Officers responded.

area: Wasco Pond Road north of West Cecil Avenue, Wasco area
summary: Grass fire near Wasco Pond Road drew an engine, a patrol unit and additional assistance. Fire progression was stopped and crews were released.

area: northbound Highway 99 south of Olive Drive
summary: Small roadside fire reported by CHP on northbound Highway 99 south of Olive Drive; crews responded and handled.
A reported vehicle fire on Elk Hills Road drew a first-alarm response before crews confirmed it was a dropped flare with no active fire, and cleared.

area: Virginia Avenue and Powell Street area
summary: Court order violation at Virginia and Powell with a male subject making threats to obtain a firearm. Additional officers responded.
Short foot pursuit of a male on a dirt bike running along a bike path; visual was lost at Chester Avenue. Units searching.
Male transient, possibly under the influence, repeatedly returning to an abandoned residence. Officers investigating.

area: near Mount Vernon Bridge, Kentucky Street area
summary: Search for a subject last seen heading eastbound toward the Mount Vernon Bridge, described in dark clothing and blue pants. Units searching.
Welfare check on a 15-year-old reported missing and last seen in a gray SUV. Officers attempting to locate.

agency: Bakersfield Police Department / Kern County Fire Department
summary: Female in a mental health crisis at a residence; medics and officers responding.
Reports of a 17-year-old making suicidal statements at a residence; family contacted. Officers and medics responding.
Verbal domestic with juveniles heard crying in the background and a female heard crying. Officers responding given concern for children.
Caller reported a family member walking on the right-hand shoulder of northbound I-5 near the escape ramp. CHP responding.
